body.p:
21
The Governor transmitted to the General Assembly through the Secretary of State a Joint Resolution of Congress to amend the Constitution of the United States:
Also the Credentials of Wm C. Daniel Commissioner from the State of Georgia together with the resolutions appointing him.
He approved and Signed enrolled Bills Chapters 178. 179. 180 & 181.

He issued a requisition on Ohio for the apprehension of Henry and Morris Swartz alias Henry and Morris Hall charged by affidavit with felony committed in Daviess county: and appointed Wm S. Stone agent to make said demand.
Also a requisition on Louisiana for Robt Morris (a free man of color) charged by indictment with felony committed in the county of Jefferson; and appointed Wm Clator agent to make the demand.
He pardoned Andrew Dunn Convicted of Grand Larceny by the Simpson Equity Court and sentenced to -- confinement one year in the Penitentiary.
He respited for six months a judgment of the Louisville City Court of $100. against Geo. McMillen for a misdemeanor
He remitted to Irvine Martin a judgment of the Jessamine Circuit Court of $50. as security of Bluford Waters.
